<thought>All three proposed precursors—p‑toluenesulfonyl chloride, 4‑aminocinnamic acid, and p‑phenylenediamine—are commercially available and inexpensive, keeping the total cost well below $9 999. The retrosynthetic plan uses two well‑known reactions: (1) amide formation (template 401931) between 4‑aminocinnamic acid and p‑phenylenediamine to give the aniline intermediate bearing the trans‑cinnamoyl‑amide side chain, and (2) sulfonamide formation (template 214705) between that intermediate and p‑toluenesulfonyl chloride to afford the target molecule. This satisfies the ≤3‑step requirement.
